description.value: Beaufort Cycles is a full-service bike shop and rental destination located in Cumberland, BC, steps from the celebrated Cumberland Mountain Bike Trail Network. With over 10 years of local riding experience, the shop offers comprehensive repairs including suspension servicing, wheel building, and e-bike diagnostics for all brands. Touring cyclists will find a capable mechanical team and a premium rental fleet in one of Vancouver Island's premier trail towns.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business as an active bike shop and rental hub in Cumberland, BC. The service page explicitly lists comprehensive repair services including e-bike diagnostics, and the rentals page confirms mountain bike rentals. OSM tag service:bicycle:pump=yes supports pump availability, and the website corroborates contact details (phone, address).
concerns: OSM address ('4640 Cumberland Road') lacks city, province, and postal code; website provides full address '4640 Cumberland Rd, Cumberland, BC V0R 1S0' which is used here.
OSM opening_hours (Tu-Fr only) omits Monday and Sunday hours listed on the website — OSM hours may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active bike shop with verified repairs, e-bike servicing, and rentals located directly adjacent to the Cumberland MTB Trail Network — a clear fit for touring cyclists on Vancouver Island.
